objectives.description: Re-derive occurrence list via grep -rn '@\.claude/docs' agent-system/extensions/
Confirm each occurrence is a prose citation, not a live @-import
Convert each prose citation to backticked plain path
Confirm each cited path still exists on disk

live_derivation.note: Matches the plan's Scope Hypothesis (15 occurrences across 8 files) exactly -- the only phase where the live re-derivation matched the plan's stated estimate rather than drifting.
live_derivation.genuine_import_investigation: meta-builder-agent.md's 4 occurrences sit inside a '## Context References' section whose adjacent 'analyze mode' comment claims 'static @-syntax cannot be used here; it would load the agent's own deployed copy instead', raising the plan's named risk of a genuine live @-import. Investigated via direct first-hand evidence: this implementing agent's own dispatch instructions (this same general-implementation-agent.md contract) carry an identically-shaped '## Context References' section with backtick-wrapped @.claude/context/... paths annotated '(always load)' / '(when creating summary)' etc., and those paths were NOT auto-expanded into this session's context at dispatch time -- they required manual Read/ToolSearch action, exactly like any other prose pointer. Confirmed: no live @-import mechanism operates on agent .md files' Context References sections in this system; all 15 occurrences (across all 8 files, including the 4 'Related Documentation'-style bullet lists in thin-wrapper-skill.md, component-checklist.md, system-overview.md, and fork-patterns.md) are stale prose citations, none is a named residual.
live_derivation.scope_boundary_note: Several files (fork-patterns.md, meta-builder-agent.md, thin-wrapper-skill.md, component-checklist.md) carry sibling @.claude/context/... and @.claude/templates/... references in the same bullet lists / tables as the targeted @.claude/docs/... lines. These are OUT of this phase's declared grep-derived scope (@\.claude/docs only) and were deliberately left untouched, not silently expanded to.
